an5.102:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ussaṅkitaparisaṅkito hoti, pāpabhikkhūti api akuppadhammo.
an5.102:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vesiyagocaro vā hoti, vidhavagocarovā hoti, thullakumārigocarovā hoti, paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti. bhikkhunī gocaro vā hoti.
an5.102:3.1: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu ussaṅkita parisaṅkito hoti pāpabhikkhūti api akuppadhammoti.
